summary: The biggest gap is systematic omission of 数据流 sections across all testing modules (204 missing instances, 18/24 modules affected), combined with the use of grouped file blocks that share one set of sections for multiple files. Together these cause 80% of file blocks to be incomplete (61/305 complete = 20%). The Skill instructions are correct and unambiguous — this is agent non-compliance. Secondary issue: Phase 4 module renaming was not completed, leaving ## headings as module_id-derived names (Asynpool, Gcs, Azureblockblob) rather than functional descriptions. Fix priority: (1) add explicit 数据流 template for test files with example, (2) prohibit grouped file blocks, (3) enforce Phase 4 heading renaming with validation rule, (4) add quantitative Phase 3→4 gate for section completeness.
